description: Verkeersintensiteiten provinciale wegen Flevoland is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by stdlcuropendataprod.blob.core.windows.net. The province of Flevoland uses filtered annual averages of traffic intensities for various analyses. We like to share these datasets with the general public. The datasets all contain the years 2018 to 2024. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic intensities provincial roads Flevoland" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Verkeersintensiteit, flevoland. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
